summary: Renames and deletes point, vertex, primitive, and detail attributes on SOP geometry using explicit rename pairs and pattern-based delete fields.

key_params.name: ptdel
key_params.note: Point attributes to delete; supports pattern matching

common_gotchas: Delete patterns can match broad scopes; '*' removes all attributes of that class.
Keep capture/deform attributes together: pCapt, pCaptPath, and pCaptData are interdependent.
The rename pages are class-specific, so a point rename does not affect vertex or primitive attributes.
key_concepts: Attribute SOP deletes and renames SOP attributes on point, vertex, primitive, and detail classes.
Delete fields use pattern matching, including broad wildcard patterns and exclusions.
Rename entries are class-specific, so a point attribute rename does not affect vertex, primitive, or detail attributes.
Capture/deform companion attributes such as pCapt, pCaptPath, and pCaptData should be treated as a related set.
